researcherGrade.basis: Actual source music pages1,3,4 (PDF5,7,8) inspected. Slow quarter60–69 exposes first-cello tenor-clef melodic line with repeated shifts, high cantilena and expressive chromatic runs; later clef changes, harmonics and stopped chord entries. Inner parts feature slurred eighths and syncopated breathing against sustained sonorities, some double-stops. Grade5 advanced practical cello band supports these register and tone demands; no extra ensemble level for conventional shared pulse.
